hints.title: Two Largest Elements
hints.text: The maximum value of (nums[i] - 1) * (nums[j] - 1) is obtained by choosing the two largest numbers in the array.

hints.title: Find Top Two in Linear Time
hints.text: Maintain max1 and max2 as the highest and second-highest values during a single traversal.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking two largest values in a single pass takes linear time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies the top two largest elements in a single pass without sorting.
